rust_summary:
nicknames for server mods: `native_set_nickname` shows a name in place of a player's in chat and
the Tab list (the real one on hover), and `native_text_allowed` asks the server's chat filter, in
`native_server.rs`.
doc_summary: nicknames for server mods: `native_set_nickname(uuid, Option<&str>)` shows a name in place of a player's in chat (their messages, `/me`, `/msg`) and the Tab list, the real name on hover and everywhere else; `native_text_allowed(text)` asks the server's chat filter. Both outside a player's hook. Bundles need "hooks": @API:native-nicknames@.
